headline: Premier League live updates: Villa lead Newcastle, Man City's Haaland gets brace
description: More goals for Erling Haaland as Manchester City defeat Ipswich Town, as Newcastle United host Aston Villa. Follow live with ESPN.

headline: Premier League VAR review: Should Brentford's Yarmoliuk have been sent off vs. Liverpool?
description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.

headline: Erling Haaland brace helps Man City hold off Ipswich at defiant Etihad Stadium
description: Erling Haaland struck twice as defiant Manchester City marched on at the top of the Premier League by holding on for a 3-2 win over Ipswich.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: JJ Gabriel move revealed soon amid Barcelona, Real Madrid talks
description: JJ Gabriel's next move could be announced soon, while Arsenal and Liverpool will battle to sign Brentford's Kevin Schade. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Alexander Isak completes Liverpool comeback at nine-man Brentford
description: Alexander Isak marked his return from injury with the winner as Liverpool came from behind to beat nine-man Brentford 2-1.

headline: Alex Iwobi goal earns Alvaro Arbeloa's Fulham their first Premier League win
description: Fulham's winless run under Alvaro Arbeloa was finally ended by an entertaining 1-0 victory over Hull at Craven Cottage.
